<script>
/* 退款与售后独立查询；登记执行、平台凭证和非退款费用分别保留。 */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 if(window.raDashboard?.initialized)return;
 const el=id=>document.getElementById(id),esc=value=>String(value??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,char=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[char]));
 const numeric=value=>typeof value==='number'&&Number.isFinite(value),number=value=>numeric(value)?value.toLocaleString('zh-CN',{maximumFractionDigits:2}):'—';
 const colors=['#496f9e','#dc9038','#8c74ad','#6a939b','#a89470','#9aabc0','#7896b1','#a1849c'];
 const platformName=value=>value==='Shopify'?'独立站':value||'平台待核';
 const unknown=value=>!value||/^(?:待核|未标|未知|未填|无|—)/.test(String(value));
 const sourceData=JSON.parse(el('refundAftersalesDetailData')?.textContent||'null');
 if(!sourceData)return;
 const data={meta:sourceData.meta||{},refundRows:sourceData.refundRows||[],aftersaleRows:sourceData.aftersaleRows||[],platformRows:sourceData.platformRows||[]};
 const state={tab:'refunds',start:'',end:'',platform:'',store:'',status:'',scope:'kept',search:'',type:'',cause:'',responsibility:'',month:'',undatedOnly:false,metric:'records',currency:'',sort:'date',direction:-1,page:0,pageSize:50,detailId:null};
 let pane,body,dialog,previousFocus=null,inputTimer;
 const metricLabels={records:'登记记录数',orders:'去重订单数',amount:'登记退款金额',actual:'登记已完成金额',replacement:'已列非退款费用'};
 const dimLabels={platform:'平台',type:'处理类型',cause:'问题原因',responsibility:'责任归属',month:'月份'};
 const values={platform:row=>row.platform||'平台待核',type:row=>row.typeLabel||'类型待核',cause:row=>row.causeLabel||'原因待核',responsibility:row=>row.responsibilityLabel||'责任待核',month:row=>validDate(row.date)?row.date.slice(0,7):'日期待核'};
 function validDate(value){return typeof value==='string'&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value);}
 function rawRows(){return state.tab==='refunds'?data.refundRows:state.tab==='platform'?data.platformRows:data.aftersaleRows;}
 function eligible(row){return (!row.disposition||row.disposition==='kept')&&row.includeInMetrics!==false;}
 function storeName(row){return typeof rfStore==='function'?rfStore(row.platform,row.store):String(row.store||'店铺待核').trim();}
 function orderKey(row){return row.orderKey||[row.platform||'',storeName(row),String(row.orderId||'').trim()].join('|');}
 function hasOrder(row){return !!row.orderId&&!unknown(row.orderId);}
 function countOrders(rows){return new Set(rows.filter(hasOrder).map(orderKey)).size;}
 function isReview(row){return row.isGoodReview===true||row.measureKind==='review_rebate'||/好评|评价返现/.test(row.typeLabel||'');}
 function isReplacement(row){return row.isReplacement===true||/补发|重发|换货/.test(row.typeLabel||'')||[row.replacementGoodsCost,row.replacementShippingCost,row.replacementOtherCost,row.replacementTotalCost].some(value=>numeric(value)&&value>0);}
 function currency(row,kind='amount'){return kind==='replacement'?row.replacementCurrency||row.replacementCostCurrency||row.replacementTotalCost_currency||'USD':row.currency||'未标币种';}
 function money(value,unit){if(!numeric(value))return '—';const prefix=unit==='USD'?'USD $':unit==='CNY'||unit==='RMB'?'CNY ¥':unit==='未标币种'?'未标币种 ':String(unit||'币种待核')+' ';return prefix+value.toLocaleString('zh-CN',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});}
 function shortMoney(value,unit){return numeric(value)?money(value,unit):'待核';}
 function metricEntry(row,metric){
  if(metric==='amount')return numeric(row.amount)?{value:row.amount,currency:currency(row)}:null;
  if(metric==='actual')return numeric(row.actualRefundAmount)?{value:row.actualRefundAmount,currency:currency(row)}:null;
  if(metric==='replacement'&&eligible(row)&&row.replacementIncludeInTotals===true)return numeric(row.replacementTotalCost)?{value:row.replacementTotalCost,currency:currency(row,'replacement')}:null;
  return null;
 }
 function sumCurrencies(rows,metric){const groups=new Map();for(const row of rows){const item=metricEntry(row,metric);if(item)groups.set(item.currency,(groups.get(item.currency)||0)+item.value);}return [...groups].sort((a,b)=>a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));}
 function moneyLines(rows,metric){const sums=sumCurrencies(rows,metric);return sums.length?'<div class="ra-money-lines">'+sums.map(([unit,value])=>'<strong>'+esc(money(value,unit))+'</strong>').join('')+'</div>':'<strong class="ra-missing">待核／无已列金额</strong>';}
 function sourceLabel(row){const source=row.source||{},name=String(source.file||source.path||'').split(/[\\/]/).pop();return [name,source.sheet,source.row?'行 '+source.row:source.rows?.length?'行 '+source.rows.join(','):source.pointer||''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')||'来源位置待核';}
 function matchNonDate(row,ignore=''){
  const query=state.search.trim().toLowerCase();
   const excluded=String(row.disposition||'').startsWith('excluded');
   if(state.scope==='kept'&&!eligible(row)||state.scope==='excluded'&&!excluded||state.scope==='review'&&(eligible(row)||excluded))return false;
   if(ignore!=='platform'&&state.platform&&values.platform(row)!==state.platform)return false;
   if(state.store&&storeName(row)!==state.store)return false;
   if(state.status&&(row.status||'状态待核')!==state.status)return false;
   if(query&&![row.orderId,row.platform,storeName(row),...(row.skus||[]),row.typeLabel,row.causeLabel,row.description].some(value=>String(value||'').toLowerCase().includes(query)))return false;
   for(const key of ['type','cause','responsibility','month'])if(ignore!==key&&state[key]&&values[key](row)!==state[key])return false;
   return true;
 }
 function matchRows(ignore=''){
  return rawRows().filter(row=>{
   if(!matchNonDate(row,ignore))return false;
   const date=validDate(row.date)?row.date:null;
   return state.undatedOnly?!date:!!date&&(!state.start||date>=state.start)&&(!state.end||date<=state.end);
  });
 }
 function metricValue(rows){
  if(state.metric==='records')return rows.length;
  if(state.metric==='orders')return countOrders(rows);
  const entries=rows.map(row=>metricEntry(row,state.metric)).filter(item=>item&&item.currency===state.currency);return entries.length?entries.reduce((sum,item)=>sum+item.value,0):null;
 }
 function groupRows(rows,dimension){const result=new Map();for(const row of rows){const key=values[dimension](row);if(!result.has(key))result.set(key,[]);result.get(key).push(row);}return [...result].map(([key,items])=>({key,rows:items,value:metricValue(items)})).sort((a,b)=>(b.value??-Infinity)-(a.value??-Infinity)||a.key.localeCompare(b.key));}
 function metricText(value){return ['records','orders'].includes(state.metric)?number(value):shortMoney(value,state.currency);}
 function metricUnit(){return state.metric==='records'?'条记录':state.metric==='orders'?'单':state.currency||'币种待核';}
 function options(items,selected,allLabel,label=value=>value){return (allLabel?'<option value="">'+esc(allLabel)+'</option>':'')+items.map(item=>'<option value="'+esc(item)+'" '+(item===selected?'selected':'')+'>'+esc(label(item))+'</option>').join('');}
 function dateBounds(){const dates=rawRows().map(row=>row.date).filter(validDate).sort();return {start:dates[0]||'',end:dates[dates.length-1]||''};}
 function latestWindow(){const bounds=dateBounds(),until=bounds.end;if(!until||state.tab==='platform')return bounds;const start=new Date(until+'T12:00:00Z');start.setUTCDate(start.getUTCDate()-29);return {start:start.toISOString().slice(0,10),end:until};}
 const relatedIndex=new Map();
 for(const item of [...data.refundRows.map(row=>({...row,_dataset:'refunds'})),...data.aftersaleRows.map(row=>({...row,_dataset:'aftersales'}))]){const key=orderKey(item);if(!relatedIndex.has(key))relatedIndex.set(key,[]);relatedIndex.get(key).push(item);}
 function linkedRows(row){if(!hasOrder(row)||unknown(row.platform)||unknown(storeName(row)))return [];return relatedIndex.get(orderKey(row))||[];}
 function coverageText(){const coverage=data.meta.coverage?.[state.tab]||{},bounds=dateBounds();return (state.undatedOnly?'仅查看日期待核记录；这些金额不归入所选期间。':(coverage.dateBasis|| (state.tab==='refunds'?'按台账退款完成日；无完成日单列待核':'按售后发生日'))+' · 当前 '+(state.start||'不限')+'—'+(state.end||'不限'))+' · 源内有日期记录 '+(coverage.start||bounds.start||'待核')+'—'+(coverage.end||bounds.end||'待核');}
 function updateControls(){
  const platforms=[...new Set(rawRows().map(row=>values.platform(row)))].sort(),stores=[...new Set(rawRows().filter(row=>!state.platform||values.platform(row)===state.platform).map(storeName))].sort(),statuses=[...new Set(rawRows().map(row=>row.status||'状态待核'))].sort();
  el('raPlatform').innerHTML=options(platforms,state.platform,'全部平台',platformName);el('raStore').innerHTML=options(stores,state.store,'全部店铺');el('raStatus').innerHTML=options(statuses,state.status,'全部执行状态');
  el('raStart').value=state.start;el('raEnd').value=state.end;el('raStart').disabled=el('raEnd').disabled=state.undatedOnly;el('raSearch').value=state.search;el('raScope').value=state.scope;
  el('raCoverage').textContent=coverageText();
  const unknownDates=rawRows().filter(row=>!validDate(row.date)&&matchNonDate(row,'month')).length;el('raUndated').textContent=state.undatedOnly?'返回有日期记录':'查看日期待核 '+unknownDates+' 条';el('raUndated').classList.toggle('primary',state.undatedOnly);
  document.querySelectorAll('#raPane [data-ra-tab]').forEach(node=>{node.classList.toggle('active',node.dataset.raTab===state.tab);node.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(node.dataset.raTab===state.tab));});
 }
 function chartControls(){
  const currencies=[...new Set(matchRows().map(row=>metricEntry(row,state.metric)?.currency).filter(Boolean))].sort();if(!currencies.includes(state.currency))state.currency=currencies[0]||'未标币种';
  const allowed=Object.entries(metricLabels).filter(([key])=>state.tab!=='platform'||['records','orders'].includes(key));
  return '<div class="ra-chart-controls"><strong>点击图表筛选明细，再点同一图形取消</strong><div><label>图表指标 <select id="raMetric">'+allowed.map(([key,label])=>'<option value="'+key+'" '+(state.metric===key?'selected':'')+'>'+label+'</option>').join('')+'</select></label>'+(!['records','orders'].includes(state.metric)?'<label>金额币种 <select id="raCurrency">'+options(currencies,state.currency,'')+'</select></label>':'')+'</div></div>';
 }
 function kpis(rows){
  if(state.tab==='platform')return platformKpis(rows);
  const related=new Set(rows.filter(row=>linkedRows(row).some(r=>r._dataset!==(state.tab==='refunds'?'refunds':'aftersales'))).map(orderKey)).size;
  const list=state.tab==='refunds'?[
   ['退款登记订单', '<strong>'+countOrders(rows)+'</strong>',rows.length+' 条登记记录；同平台＋店铺＋订单去重'],
   ['登记退款金额',moneyLines(rows,'amount'),'按原表币种分列；未标币种不并入USD'],
   ['登记已完成金额',moneyLines(rows,'actual'),'仅台账完成日期／执行备注支持；不等于平台账单核销'],
   ['其中：好评返现登记',moneyLines(rows.filter(isReview),'amount'),'是登记金额的子集，不再与登记总额相加'],
   ['关联售后：已列非退款费用',moneyLines([...new Map(rows.flatMap(linkedRows).filter(row=>row._dataset==='aftersales'&&eligible(row)).map(row=>[row.id,row])).values()],'replacement'),'费用小计可不完整；不加入退款金额，不视为实际付款'],
   ['可关联售后的订单','<strong>'+related+'</strong>','按同平台、规范店铺和订单号精确匹配；未匹配不代表无售后']
  ]:[
   ['售后登记订单','<strong>'+countOrders(rows)+'</strong>',rows.length+' 条售后记录；同单多次处理可对应多行'],
   ['非返现售后记录','<strong>'+rows.filter(row=>!isReview(row)).length+'</strong>','客户、物流、产品及其他原因分别展示；此处不是质量售后率'],
   ['其中：有补发／重发记录','<strong>'+countOrders(rows.filter(isReplacement))+'</strong>','补发方式与问题原因分开；不把补发当退款'],
   ['已列非退款费用',moneyLines(rows,'replacement'),'仅汇总允许计入的已列小计；缺少费用分项仍待核'],
   ['可关联退款登记订单','<strong>'+related+'</strong>','同一退款可能已在另一张表登记；不跨表二次求和'],
   ['责任仍待核','<strong>'+rows.filter(row=>unknown(row.responsibilityLabel)||/待核/.test(row.responsibilityLabel||'')).length+'</strong>','不根据“破损”等描述直接认定工厂或物流责任']
  ];
  return '<div class="ra-kpis">'+list.map(([label,value,note],index)=>'<section class="ra-kpi '+(value.includes('ra-money-lines')?'money ':'')+(index===1||index===2?'negative':'')+'"><span>'+esc(label)+'</span>'+value+'<small>'+esc(note)+'</small></section>').join('')+'</div>';
 }
 function platformKpis(rows){
  const labels={Amazon:['客户退款账单组件','bookRefund'],Shopify:['成功现金退款','cashRefund'],Wayfair:['已结算退款／退货扣款','bookRefund']};
  const cards=['Amazon','Shopify','Wayfair'].map(platform=>{const group=rows.filter(row=>row.platform===platform&&eligible(row)&&row.isPrimary),field=labels[platform][1],known=group.map(row=>row[field]).filter(numeric),sum=known.length?known.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0):null;return '<section class="ra-kpi negative"><span>'+esc(platformName(platform)+' · '+labels[platform][0])+'</span><strong>'+esc(sum==null?'未覆盖／无明示金额':money(sum,'USD'))+'</strong><small>'+countOrders(group)+' 单 / '+group.length+' 条主凭证；'+(platform==='Amazon'?'posted退款账单，非银行到账':platform==='Shopify'?'原生成功交易，含税／运费／服务，未分摊SKU':'供应商已结算扣款；部分USD按原账户暂算')+'</small></section>';});
  return '<div class="ra-kpis">'+cards.join('')+'</div><div class="ra-callout">原三平台凭证完整覆盖仅2026年10月。三类金额口径不同，不合成现金退款总额；组件明细可能来自同一退款，不横向求和。</div>';
 }
 function dimTitle(dimension){return {platform:'平台分布',type:state.tab==='refunds'?'退款用途 / 处理类型':state.tab==='platform'?'平台凭证类型':'售后处理方式',cause:'问题原因 · 好评返现另列',responsibility:'责任归属',month:'月度记录 / 金额趋势'}[dimension];}
 function pickAttrs(dimension,key){return ' data-ra-pick="'+dimension+'" data-ra-value="'+esc(key)+'"';}
 function bars(dimension){
  const original=matchRows(dimension),rows=dimension==='cause'?original.filter(row=>!isReview(row)):original,groups=groupRows(rows,dimension),max=Math.max(0,...groups.map(row=>row.value||0)),total=groups.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+(row.value||0),0),selected=state[dimension];
  if(!groups.length)return '<div class="ra-empty">所选条件没有可展示记录；无覆盖或金额缺失不表示零。</div>';
  return '<div class="ra-bars">'+groups.map((row,index)=>'<button class="ra-bar '+(selected===row.key?'selected':selected?'muted':'')+'" '+pickAttrs(dimension,row.key)+' aria-pressed="'+(selected===row.key)+'"><span>'+esc(row.key)+'</span><i><em style="width:'+(max>0?Math.max(0,row.value||0)/max*100:0).toFixed(3)+'%;background:'+colors[index%colors.length]+'"></em></i><b>'+esc(metricText(row.value))+'<small>'+(total>0&&numeric(row.value)?(row.value/total*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'无可计算占比')+'</small></b></button>').join('')+'</div>';
 }
 function donut(){
  const groups=groupRows(matchRows('platform'),'platform'),total=groups.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+Math.max(0,row.value||0),0),selected=state.platform;let offset=0;
  const arcs=groups.map((row,index)=>{const share=total>0?Math.max(0,row.value||0)/total:0,length=share*100,element='<circle r="37" cx="60" cy="60" pathLength="100" fill="none" stroke="'+colors[index%colors.length]+'" stroke-width="13" stroke-dasharray="'+length+' '+(100-length)+'" stroke-dashoffset="'+(-offset)+'" transform="rotate(-90 60 60)" opacity="'+(selected&&selected!==row.key?'.22':'1')+'" '+pickAttrs('platform',row.key)+' tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="'+esc(platformName(row.key)+' '+metricText(row.value))+'"><title>'+esc(platformName(row.key)+' '+metricText(row.value))+'</title></circle>';offset+=length;return element;});
  return '<div class="ra-donut-layout"><svg class="ra-donut" viewBox="0 0 120 120" role="img" aria-label="平台分布，圆环保留当前其他条件下的原占比"><circle r="37" cx="60" cy="60" fill="none" stroke="#edf2f7" stroke-width="13"/>'+arcs.join('')+'<text x="60" y="56" text-anchor="middle" class="ra-ring-label">'+esc(metricLabels[state.metric])+'</text><text x="60" y="70" text-anchor="middle" class="ra-ring-total">'+esc(['records','orders'].includes(state.metric)?number(total):total.toLocaleString('zh-CN',{notation:'compact',maximumFractionDigits:1}))+'</text><text x="60" y="82" text-anchor="middle" class="ra-ring-label">'+esc(metricUnit())+'</text></svg><div>'+groups.map((row,index)=>'<button class="ra-pie-key '+(selected===row.key?'selected':selected?'muted':'')+'" '+pickAttrs('platform',row.key)+' aria-pressed="'+(selected===row.key)+'"><i style="background:'+colors[index%colors.length]+'"></i><span>'+esc(platformName(row.key))+'</span><b>'+esc(total>0&&numeric(row.value)?(Math.max(0,row.value)/total*100).toFixed(1)+'%':'—')+'<small>'+esc(metricText(row.value))+'</small></b></button>').join('')+'</div></div>';
 }
 function trend(){
  const groups=groupRows(matchRows('month'),'month').filter(row=>row.key!=='日期待核').sort((a,b)=>a.key.localeCompare(b.key));if(!groups.length)return '<div class="ra-empty">日期待核记录不放入月度趋势，避免把未知日期计入当前月份。</div>';
  const width=Math.max(550,groups.length*50+100),height=240,left=66,right=18,top=32,bottom=44,innerW=width-left-right,innerH=height-top-bottom,max=Math.max(1,...groups.map(row=>Math.max(0,row.value||0))),step=innerW/Math.max(1,groups.length-1),x=index=>left+(groups.length===1?innerW/2:index*step),y=value=>top+innerH-(Math.max(0,value||0)/max*innerH),selected=state.month;
  let svg='<svg class="ra-trend" viewBox="0 0 '+width+' '+height+'" role="img" aria-label="月度趋势，横轴月份，纵轴'+esc(metricLabels[state.metric]+' '+metricUnit())+'">';
  for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){const value=max*i/4,py=y(value);svg+='<line class="ra-grid" x1="'+left+'" x2="'+(width-right)+'" y1="'+py+'" y2="'+py+'"/><text text-anchor="end" x="'+(left-9)+'" y="'+(py+4)+'">'+esc(number(value))+'</text>';}
  svg+='<text x="'+left+'" y="14">'+esc(metricLabels[state.metric]+'（'+metricUnit()+'）')+'</text><path class="ra-line" d="'+groups.map((row,index)=>(index?'L':'M')+x(index).toFixed(1)+' '+y(row.value).toFixed(1)).join(' ')+'"/>';
  groups.forEach((row,index)=>{const px=x(index),py=y(row.value),muted=selected&&selected!==row.key?' muted':'';svg+='<rect class="ra-trend-hit" '+pickAttrs('month',row.key)+' x="'+(px-Math.max(18,step/2))+'" y="'+top+'" width="'+Math.max(36,step)+'" height="'+innerH+'"/><circle '+pickAttrs('month',row.key)+' class="ra-point '+(selected===row.key?'selected':'')+muted+'" cx="'+px+'" cy="'+py+'" r="4" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="'+esc(row.key+' '+metricText(row.value))+'"><title>'+esc(row.key+' '+metricText(row.value))+'</title></circle><text x="'+px+'" y="'+(height-22)+'" text-anchor="middle" class="'+muted+'">'+esc(row.key)+'</text>'+(groups.length<=14?'<text x="'+px+'" y="'+(py-9)+'" text-anchor="middle" class="'+muted+'">'+esc(number(row.value))+'</text>':'');});
  return '<div class="ra-trend-scroll">'+svg+'<text x="'+(width-18)+'" y="'+(height-3)+'" text-anchor="end">日期（月份）</text></svg></div>';
 }
 function charts(){const dims=state.tab==='aftersales'?['platform','type','cause','responsibility']:['platform','type','cause','month'];return chartControls()+'<div class="ra-charts">'+dims.map(dimension=>'<section class="ra-chart"><h3>'+esc(dimTitle(dimension))+'<span>'+esc(metricLabels[state.metric]+' · '+metricUnit())+'</span></h3>'+(dimension==='platform'?donut():dimension==='month'?trend():bars(dimension))+'<p class="ra-note">'+(dimension==='platform'?'平台点选只标记亮暗，圆环角度和原占比不变；其他图表及明细联动。':dimension==='cause'?'展示问题原因，不代表责任认定；好评返现不是产品质量问题，已从此图排除。':dimension==='responsibility'?'只按来源已标注责任展示；未能证实的归属保留待核。':dimension==='month'?'横轴为月份，纵轴为当前指标。点击一个月筛选，再点恢复。':'每条记录只归一个当前处理类型；同一订单多次处理可能分别登记。')+'</p></section>').join('')+'</div>';
 }
 function breadcrumbs(){return '<div class="ra-context"><span>当前图表点选：</span>'+(['platform','type','cause','responsibility','month'].filter(key=>state[key]).map(key=>'<span class="ra-chip">'+esc(dimLabels[key]+'：'+(key==='platform'?platformName(state[key]):state[key]))+'<button data-ra-clear="'+key+'" aria-label="清除'+esc(dimLabels[key])+'">×</button></span>').join('')||'<span>全部</span>')+'<button class="ra-link" data-ra-clear-charts>清除图表点选</button></div>';}
 const sortFields={date:row=>row.date,orderId:row=>row.orderId,platform:row=>platformName(row.platform)+' / '+storeName(row),typeLabel:row=>row.typeLabel,causeLabel:row=>row.causeLabel,responsibilityLabel:row=>row.responsibilityLabel,amount:row=>row.amount,actualRefundAmount:row=>row.actualRefundAmount,replacementTotalCost:row=>row.replacementTotalCost,cashRefund:row=>row.cashRefund,productRefund:row=>row.productRefund,bookRefund:row=>row.bookRefund,status:row=>row.status};
 function sortedRows(rows){const read=sortFields[state.sort]||sortFields.date;return [...rows].sort((a,b)=>{const av=read(a),bv=read(b),am=av==null||av==='',bm=bv==null||bv==='';if(am||bm)return am===bm?String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)):am?1:-1;const result=numeric(av)&&numeric(bv)?av-bv:String(av).localeCompare(String(bv),'zh-CN',{numeric:true});return result*state.direction||String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id));});}
 function sortHead(label,key){return '<th aria-sort="'+(state.sort===key?(state.direction===1?'ascending':'descending'):'none')+'"><button data-ra-sort="'+key+'">'+esc(label)+(state.sort===key?(state.direction===1?' ↑':' ↓'):' ↕')+'</button></th>';}
 function skuHtml(row){return (row.skus||[]).map(sku=>'<button class="ra-link" data-ra-sku="'+esc(sku)+'">'+esc(sku)+'</button>').join(' / ')||'<span class="ra-missing">SKU待核</span>';}
 function rowMoney(row,field){return numeric(row[field])?esc(money(row[field],currency(row,field==='replacementTotalCost'?'replacement':'amount'))):'<span class="ra-missing">待核</span>';}
 function currencyFootnote(row){return {user_confirmed:'币种：用户确认'+(row.currency||''),matched_user_confirmed_refund_register:'币种：匹配已确认退款登记',matched_primary_currency:'币种：平台凭证匹配',explicit_text_currency:'币种：原文明确标注',source_missing:'原表未标币种'}[row.currencyStatus]||(row.currency&&row.currency!=='未标币种'?'币种：'+row.currency:'原表未标币种');}
 function table(rows){

  const ordered=sortedRows(rows),pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(rows.length/state.pageSize));state.page=Math.min(state.page,pages-1);const displayed=ordered.slice(state.page*state.pageSize,(state.page+1)*state.pageSize);
  const headers=[['发生 / 完成日期','date'],['平台 / 店铺','platform'],['订单 / SKU','orderId'],['处理类型 / 退款范围','typeLabel'],['问题原因 / 责任','causeLabel'],['登记退款金额','amount'],['登记已完成金额','actualRefundAmount'],['已列非退款费用','replacementTotalCost'],['执行状态','status']];

class="ra-btn" data-ra-export>导出当前明细</button></div></div>'+(displayed.length?'<div class="ra-table-scroll"><table class="ra-table"><thead><tr>'+headers.map(([label,key])=>sortHead(label,key)).join('')+'<th>来源与详情</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+displayed.map(row=>'<tr data-ra-row="'+esc(row.id)+'"><td>'+esc(row.date||'日期待核')+'<small>'+esc(row.dateBasis||'')+'</small></td><td>'+esc(platformName(row.platform))+'<small>'+esc(storeName(row))+'</small></td><td><button class="ra-link ra-order" data-ra-detail="'+esc(row.id)+'">'+esc(row.orderId||'订单号待核')+'</button><small>'+skuHtml(row)+'</small></td><td><span class="ra-pill '+(isReview(row)?'marketing':'')+'">'+esc(row.typeLabel||'类型待核')+'</span><small>'+esc(row.refundScope||'退款范围未核')+'</small></td><td class="ra-description">'+esc(row.causeLabel||'原因待核')+'<small>'+esc(row.responsibilityLabel||'责任待核')+(row.causeInferred?' · 描述归类，非责任认定':'')+'</small></td><td>'+rowMoney(row,'amount')+'<small>'+esc(currencyFootnote(row))+'</small></td><td>'+rowMoney(row,'actualRefundAmount')+'<small>登记执行证据；非平台核销</small></td><td>'+rowMoney(row,'replacementTotalCost')+'<small>'+esc(row.replacementTotalLabel||'不含退款；已列分项可能不完整')+(row.replacementIncludeInTotals===false?' · 未计汇总':'')+'</small></td><td>'+esc(row.status||'状态待核')+'<small>'+esc(row.refundCompletedDate||row.completedDate||'')+'</small></td><td><button class="ra-link" data-ra-detail="'+esc(row.id)+'">查看订单与费用依据</button><small>'+esc(sourceLabel(row))+'</small></td></tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>':'<div class="ra-empty">当前筛选没有匹配登记记录。平台凭证与登记台账覆盖不同，不能据此认定没有实际退款或没有售后。</div>')+'<div class="ra-page"><span>金额按各自币种展示；登记退款、平台凭证与费用小计不横向相加。</span><button class="ra-btn" data-ra-page="-1" '+(state.page===0?'disabled':'')+'>上一页</button><span>'+(state.page+1)+' / '+pages+'</span><button class="ra-btn" data-ra-page="1" '+(state.page>=pages-1?'disabled':'')+'>下一页</button></div></div>';
 }
 function platformTable(rows){
  const ordered=sortedRows(rows),pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(rows.length/state.pageSize));state.page=Math.min(state.page,pages-1);const displayed=ordered.slice(state.page*state.pageSize,(state.page+1)*state.pageSize),headers=[['凭证事件日','date'],['平台 / 店铺','platform'],['订单 / SKU','orderId'],['凭证类型','typeLabel'],['关联问题原因','causeLabel'],['现金交易USD','cashRefund'],['商品分录USD','productRefund'],['账单 / 扣款USD','bookRefund'],['状态 / 计量层级','status']];
  return '<div class="ra-card"><div class="ra-table-head"><h3>平台凭证明细 · '+rows.length+'条 / '+countOrders(rows)+'单</h3><div><span>三金额分列，不横向相加</span><button class="ra-btn" data-ra-export>导出当前凭证</button></div></div>'+(displayed.length?'<div class="ra-table-scroll"><table class="ra-table"><thead><tr>'+headers.map(([label,key])=>sortHead(label,key)).join('')+'<th>来源与订单关联</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+displayed.map(row=>'<tr data-ra-row="'+esc(row.id)+'"><td>'+esc(row.date||'日期待核')+'<small>'+esc(row.dateBasis||'平台凭证事件日')+'</small></td><td>'+esc(platformName(row.platform))+'<small>'+esc(storeName(row))+'</small></td><td><button class="ra-link ra-order" data-ra-detail="'+esc(row.id)+'">'+esc(row.orderId||'订单号待核')+'</button><small>'+skuHtml(row)+'</small></td><td>'+esc(row.typeLabel||row.kind||'凭证类型待核')+'<small>'+esc(row.primaryMeasureLabel||row.amountBasis||'')+'</small></td><td>'+esc(row.causeLabel||'原因待补')+'<small>'+esc(row.responsibilityLabel||'责任待核')+'</small></td><td>'+esc(shortMoney(row.cashRefund,'USD'))+'</td><td>'+esc(shortMoney(row.productRefund,'USD'))+'</td><td>'+esc(shortMoney(row.bookRefund,'USD'))+'</td><td>'+esc(row.status||'')+'<small>'+esc(row.isPrimary?'本平台主要指标凭证':'组件或另列凭证，不另加主指标')+'</small></td><td><button class="ra-link" data-ra-detail="'+esc(row.id)+'">查看登记、售后与凭证</button><small>'+esc(sourceLabel(row))+'</small></td></tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>':'<div class="ra-empty">所选日期未找到本类已接入凭证；原凭证只完整覆盖2026年10月，不能把其他月份看作零退款。</div>')+'<div class="ra-page"><span>现金交易、商品分录、账单扣款可能属于同一笔退款；来源排除项仅在核对范围查看。</span><button class="ra-btn" data-ra-page="-1" '+(state.page===0?'disabled':'')+'>上一页</button><span>'+(state.page+1)+' / '+pages+'</span><button class="ra-btn" data-ra-page="1" '+(state.page>=pages-1?'disabled':'')+'>下一页</button></div></div>';
 }
 function boundaries(){const notes=[
  '退款台账反映登记及执行证据，原三平台账单／交易凭证反映不同财务口径；同订单可能是同一笔退款，不能直接相加。',
  '退款登记原表未标币种时单列“未标币种”；只有逐单证据支持才能补币种。补发费用字段USD与未标币种的退款不混加。',
  '售后原“总成本”可能已包含退款金额。非退款费用小计只列采购、运输、仓库等费用，不再叠加原总成本；缺失分项不补零，也不宣称完整成本或实际支付。',
  '好评返现、安装／服务费退回、税费退回和差价返还与产品售后分开；好评返现不作为产品质量问题或质量售后率的分子。',
  '问题描述、处理方式、责任归属是三个维度。“补发”不是问题原因，“破损”也不直接等同工厂或物流责任。本页只展示已有记录，不计算缺少同期间出库分母的质量售后率。',
  '日期未知记录在独立待核队列中查看，不用订单日或申请日冒充实际退款发生日。'
 ];return '<details class="ra-boundaries"><summary>金额、日期和归因口径说明</summary><ul>'+[...notes,...(data.meta.notes||[])].map(note=>'<li>'+esc(note)+'</li>').join('')+'</ul></details>';}

 function clearCharts(){for(const key of ['type','cause','responsibility','month'])state[key]='';state.platform='';state.store='';state.page=0;}
 function reset(){clearCharts();state.status='';state.scope='kept';state.search='';state.undatedOnly=false;state.metric='records';state.sort='date';state.direction=-1;Object.assign(state,latestWindow());render();}
 function choose(dimension,key){if(!Object.hasOwn(values,dimension))return;state[dimension]=state[dimension]===key?'':key;if(dimension==='platform')state.store='';state.page=0;render();}
 function evidenceFor(row){
  if(!hasOrder(row)||unknown(row.platform)||unknown(storeName(row)))return [];
  const refs=new Set(row.platformEvidenceRefs||[]),canonical=data.platformRows.filter(event=>refs.has(event.id)||orderKey(event)===orderKey(row));if(canonical.length)return canonical;
  const all=typeof rfState!=='undefined'?rfState.data?.events||[]:[];return all.filter(event=>event.disposition==='kept'&&event.platform===row.platform&&storeName(event)===storeName(row)&&String(event.orderId||'').trim()===String(row.orderId||'').trim());
 }
 function detailMeta(items){return '<dl class="ra-detail-meta">'+items.map(([label,value])=>'<dt>'+esc(label)+'</dt><dd>'+esc(value==null||value===''?'待核':value)+'</dd>').join('')+'</dl>';}
 function relatedHtml(row){const related=linkedRows(row).filter(item=>item.id!==row.id);return '<details class="ra-detail-fold" open><summary>同订单其他退款／售后登记 · '+related.length+'条</summary><p>只做订单关联，不合并求和；同一退款或返现可能在两张表重复登记。</p>'+(related.length?'<div class="ra-table-scroll"><table class="ra-table"><thead><tr><th>来源</th><th>日期</th><th>处理方式</th><th>登记金额</th><th>已列非退款费用</th><th>原始记录</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+related.map(item=>'<tr><td>'+(item._dataset==='refunds'?'退款登记':'售后登记')+'</td><td>'+esc(item.date||'日期待核')+'</td><td>'+esc(item.typeLabel||'待核')+'</td><td>'+rowMoney(item,'amount')+'</td><td>'+rowMoney(item,'replacementTotalCost')+'</td><td><button class="ra-link" data-ra-related="'+esc(item.id)+'">查看这条登记</button><small>'+esc(sourceLabel(item))+'</small></td></tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>':'<p>当前导出表中没有精确匹配的其他登记。未匹配不代表没有发生其他处理。</p>')+'</details>';}
 function platformEvidenceHtml(row){const items=evidenceFor(row),label=kind=>typeof rfKinds!=='undefined'?rfKinds[kind]||kind:kind;return '<details class="ra-detail-fold" '+(items.length?'open':'')+'><summary>原三平台已核凭证关联 · '+items.length+'条</summary><p>原凭证完整覆盖仅2026年10月；登记日期、退款账单发生日和原订单日可能不同。现金交易、商品分录、账单扣款可能是同一退款的不同层，不能相加。</p>'+(items.length?'<div class="ra-table-scroll"><table class="ra-table"><thead><tr><th>凭证事件日</th><th>凭证类型</th><th>现金交易USD</th><th>商品分录USD</th><th>账单／退货扣款USD</th><th>来源</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+items.map(item=>'<tr><td>'+esc(item.eventDate||item.date||'日期待核')+'</td><td>'+esc(label(item.kind))+'<small>'+esc(item.status||'')+'</small></td><td>'+esc(shortMoney(item.cashRefund,'USD'))+'</td><td>'+esc(shortMoney(item.productRefund,'USD'))+'</td><td>'+esc(shortMoney(item.bookRefund,'USD'))+'</td><td>'+esc(sourceLabel(item))+'</td></tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>':'<p>未找到同平台、同店铺、同订单的原10月凭证。不能据此把登记金额记为零或认定未执行；新月份尚未包含在原凭证覆盖中。</p>')+'</details>';}
 function costHtml(row){const components=row.costComponentsDetailed||row.costComponents||[],costNotes=row.costQuality||[];return '<details class="ra-detail-fold" open><summary>补发／处置费用分项与原售后总成本</summary><p>已列非退款费用不是实际付款；采购单价、物流或仓库费用缺失时，小计不代表完整成本。原售后总成本可能已含退款，不能重复加入。</p>'+detailMeta([
  ['已列采购成本',shortMoney(row.replacementGoodsCost,row.replacementGoodsCost_currency||'USD')],['已列运输／补发运费',shortMoney(row.replacementShippingCost,row.replacementShippingCost_currency||'USD')],['已列仓库等其他费用',shortMoney(row.replacementOtherCost,row.replacementOtherCost_currency||'USD')],['已列非退款费用小计',shortMoney(row.replacementTotalCost,currency(row,'replacement'))],['小计是否计入汇总',row.replacementIncludeInTotals===false?'不计入：'+(row.replacementExclusionReason||costNotes.join('；')||'待协商／估计／重复等证据待核'):'只计已列可纳入分项；缺失仍待核'],['原售后总成本（独立保留）',shortMoney(row.rawAfterSalesTotal??row.afterSalesTotalCost??row.aftersalesTotalCost??row.sourceTotalCost,row.afterSalesTotalCost_currency||'USD')],['小计依据',row.replacementTotalLabel||row.replacementAggregation||'分项尚未完整核对']
 ])+(components.length?'<div class="ra-table-scroll"><table class="ra-table"><thead><tr><th>来源费用字段</th><th>金额</th><th>状态／说明</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+components.map(item=>'<tr><td>'+esc(item.sourceColumn||item.label||item.name||item.field||'来源费用')+'</td><td>'+esc(shortMoney(item.amount??item.value,item.currency||'USD'))+'</td><td>'+esc(item.historicalReview?.reason||item.note||({registered:'原表已登记（非付款确认）',missing_or_auto_zero:'缺失或自动零，保留待核',historical_pending:'历史费用待核',historical_excluded:'历史已排除，不计入'}[item.status])||item.status||item.basis||'原表记录')+'</td></tr>').join('')+'</tbody></table></div>':'')+(costNotes.length?'<div class="ra-callout">'+esc(costNotes.join('；'))+'</div>':'')+'</details>';}
 function findRow(id){return [...data.refundRows,...data.aftersaleRows,...data.platformRows].find(row=>String(row.id)===String(id));}
 function detailKpis(row){
  const platform=!!row.kind&&data.platformRows.some(item=>item.id===row.id);
  if(platform)return '<div class="ra-detail-kpis">'+[['现金交易USD',shortMoney(row.cashRefund,'USD')],['商品分录USD',shortMoney(row.productRefund,'USD')],['账单／退货扣款USD',shortMoney(row.bookRefund,'USD')],['凭证层级',row.isPrimary?'本平台主要指标':'组件／另列记录']].map(([label,value])=>'<div><span>'+esc(label)+'</span><strong>'+esc(value)+'</strong></div>').join('')+'</div>';
  return '<div class="ra-detail-kpis"><div><span>登记退款金额</span><strong>'+rowMoney(row,'amount')+'</strong></div><div><span>登记已完成金额</span><strong>'+rowMoney(row,'actualRefundAmount')+'</strong></div><div><span>已列非退款费用</span><strong>'+rowMoney(row,'replacementTotalCost')+'</strong></div><div><span>退款范围</span><strong>'+esc(row.refundScope||'基数待核')+'</strong></div></div>';
 }

 }

 function downloadCsv(headers,rows,label){
  const safe=value=>{if(value==null)return '';if(typeof value==='number')return String(value);let text=String(value);if(/^[=+@-]/.test(text))text="'"+text;return '"'+text.replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';};
  const lines=[headers,...rows].map(line=>line.map(safe).join(',')),url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['\ufeff'+lines.join('\r\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'})),a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=url;a.download='退款与售后_'+label+'_'+(state.undatedOnly?'日期待核':state.start+'_'+state.end)+'.csv';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
 }
 function exportPlatform(){
  const headers=['凭证ID','平台','店铺','订单','SKU','凭证事件日','凭证类型','状态','归属处置','主指标凭证','主指标口径','现金交易USD','商品分录USD','账单扣款USD','关联原因','责任归属','来源定位'];
  downloadCsv(headers,sortedRows(matchRows()).map(row=>[row.id,row.platform,storeName(row),row.orderId,(row.skus||[]).join(' / '),row.date,row.typeLabel||row.kind,row.status,row.disposition,row.isPrimary?'是':'否',row.primaryMeasureLabel||row.amountBasis,row.cashRefund,row.productRefund,row.bookRefund,row.causeLabel,row.responsibilityLabel,sourceLabel(row)]),'平台凭证');
 }

  downloadCsv(headers,rows,state.tab==='refunds'?'退款登记':'售后归因');
 }
